g.text: Explicitly disabled delegation · both hosted-agent APIs · default tier
Teal: Nanocodex; orange: OpenAI Agents. Fresh sessions, two trials per cell, concurrency two.
Dots: medians; whiskers: observed ranges. This later cohort uses the final Worker version and is separate from the main matrix.
